pass_2.finding: Historical 2012 16S method uses 12-base Golay index and three custom primers. HiSeq section specifies 500 nM custom primers; MiSeq section says initially 6 then manually configure 12 index cycles, reservoirs 12 Read 1, 13 Index, 14 Read 2, with a 151×12×151 run. It calls for 15–30% PhiX on 16S amplicons, versus later EMP ITS web advice of 5–10%; these are different substrate/version instructions, not an error to overwrite. It supports index-read mechanism but cannot prove a particular ITS instrument run or its PhiX fraction.

missing_claims.claim: Exact EMP ITS MiSeq/HiSeq run setup beyond the three printed custom primer identities
missing_claims.evidence: EMP ITS site and 2018 protocols.io version direct users to Caporaso 2012 Supplementary Methods. The recovered original describes a historical 16S setup (12-index cycles, custom primer reservoirs 12/13/14, 151×12×151 and 15–30% PhiX), whereas the later ITS site specifies 5–10% PhiX and no exact read lengths. Smith–Peay Figure S1 and Walters 2016 Table S1 remain unreviewed. Exact ITS run selection is not established by these sources.

conclusion: EMP workbook and Smith–Peay 2014 support 12-base Golay indexing; EMP site and 2018 protocols.io reverse-primer placeholder print 10 N, documented on public page. Caporaso 2012 Supplementary Methods is now read as a historical 16S instrument example, not a selected ITS run. Exact ITS run settings remain blocked; several newly read linked rows need independent first passes and two relevant supplements are unread.
